status: REGISTERED BEFORE THE REPLAY TEST EXISTS. Phase 8 adds a test that replays tracking history already stored on the phone (or imported from a file made from existing recordings) through the screens and storage code. It needs no camera. criteria.json is unchanged and still governs the live-camera checks.

what_a_replay_can_and_cannot_show.can: that the review, history, comparison, export/import and deletion code and storage run correctly and fast enough in this phone's browser on real stored paths; that stored video clips decode and draw
what_a_replay_can_and_cannot_show.cannot: anything about the live camera loop: counting speed, whether counted shots change, battery, heat, how many shots the live recorder captures, hand-held camera behaviour. The report must say 'replayed data' on every replay result and must never present a replay result as live-device validation.
what_a_replay_can_and_cannot_show.synthetic: if the phone holds fewer than 20 shots with a path, the test builds synthetic sessions and labels EVERY result 'synthetic'. A synthetic pass is never reported as a pass on real data.

R1_data.rule: informational: reports real or synthetic, sessions, shots, shots with a path

R2_read.rule: reading all saved history for the player, same limit as list1000Ms

R3_draw.rule: building and drawing every stored path (up to 250), 95th percentile, same limit as renderPerShotMs

R4_analyse.rule: analysing all stored shots, same limit as analyse250Ms

R5_roundtrip.rule: export the stored history, import it into a throwaway in-memory store: same sessions, same shot count, every path point identical. Pass/fail.

R6_delete.rule: in the throwaway copy, deleting a session hides it from list, usage and analysis at once, restoring it brings every shot back, and no other session changes. Pass/fail. The real store is never written.

R7_clips.rule: up to 20 saved video clips on this phone: decode every frame and draw it with its path overlay, per-frame 95th percentile. not_measured if the phone holds no clips.

R8_nowrite.rule: the real history store is byte-identical before and after the replay test (session and shot counts and total bytes). Pass/fail.

live_only_list: kept in src/lib/review/phonetest.ts LIVE_ONLY and kept equal to this list's ids by a test: counting speed (frames per second) with review on versus off; counted shots equal between flag-on and flag-off sets; battery and heat over a set; paths captured for new live shots; clips saved by the live camera; storage surviving days; Home Screen app camera behaviour; camera-reference check hand-held.
